caption: A horse's iron shoe strikes a stone on a path in the dusk, and a spark flashes under the hoof.

sa.check: A horse walks on a path in the dusk.
A spark flashes under the hoof.
The strike comes first and the spark follows.

pc.expect: The spark is a brief flash at the instant the shoe strikes the stone, and is gone; nothing glows before or after.
pc.fail: The spark glows on under the hoof after it has lifted; or a spark appears while the hoof is in the air; or the stone glows after the strike; or sparks flash on steps where the hoof lands on soft ground.

pc.expect: One horse with four hooves; the stone stays where it is; the spark leaves nothing behind.
pc.fail: A glowing dot stays on the path after the strike; or the stone vanishes or appears from nowhere; or a hoof vanishes or a fifth appears; or a second horse appears.

pc.expect: Any spark fragments fly out from under the hoof and fall to the path, going dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the horse; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the path for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The hoof comes down onto the stone, bears weight and lifts again as the horse walks on; the stone stays put or skids a little.
pc.fail: The hoof passes through the stone; or the stone flies far off as if kicked hard while the hoof merely lands; or the hoof stops in mid-air above the stone and the spark flashes anyway.

pc.expect: One horse with its legs, head and tail throughout; the horse passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The horse gains or loses a leg; or its body changes shape; or the horse passes through a fence or tree; or the horse merges with its shadow.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The horse's coat colour, its tack and the path stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes colour or pattern; or the tack changes; or the path changes surface.

note: The horse is an animal; its gait is not judged. The horse is kept because the shoe striking the stone is the caption's physics.
